# migadu_alias (Resource)

Manages a Migadu alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "migadu_alias" "example" {
  domain_name  = "example.com"
  local_part   = "info"
  destinations = ["alice@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destinations` (List of String) List of destination addresses.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain this alias belongs to.
- `local_part` (String) The local part of the alias address.

### Optional

- `is_internal` (Boolean) Whether the alias is internal.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The full alias address.
